source_title: Aukett Swanke Group Plc Annual Report 2023
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 41, 54 and 55 state that the report and financial statements were approved by the Board on 27 March 2024; issuer report identity and preserved bytes are hash-verified locally.
observation: Continuing revenue rose to £14.34m and the Group achieved a small trading profit, but loss before tax was £0.34m, net deficit widened to £2.14m and project delays, debt repayments and acquisitions pressured cash flow. Management expected a first-half loss and highlighted high operational gearing. Acquired businesses, disposals, streamlined teams and financing arrangements were already announced, while net assets and cash improved from 2022.
already_announced_exclusion: The four acquisitions, two disposals, team streamlining, CBILS repayment plan, renewed overdraft and other actions disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Improved revenue and net assets only partly offset continuing losses, high operational gearing, project-delay exposure and materially weaker net debt; all disclosed portfolio and cost actions are excluded.
